verses.text: These are the commands, rules, and laws the LORD your God told me to teach you. Obey them in the land you are crossing over to take,
so that you, your children, and your grandchildren will fear the LORD your God as long as you live, and keep all his rules and commands that I give you. Then you will live a long life.

Listen, Israel, and be careful to obey. Then all will go well with you, and you will grow into a great nation in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your ancestors, promised you.
Listen, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is the only one.
Love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.
Keep these words that I am giving you today in your heart.
Teach them carefully to your children. Talk about them when you are sitting at home and when you are walking along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
Tie them on your hands as a sign, and wear them on your foreheads as a reminder.
Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.
The LORD your God will bring you into the land he promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you. It is a land with large, fine cities that you did not build,
houses full of good things that you did not fill, wells that you did not dig, and vineyards and olive trees that you did not plant. When you have eaten and are full,
be careful that you do not forget the LORD, who brought you out of Egypt, the land where you were slaves.
Fear the LORD your God, serve him, and make your promises only in his name.
Do not follow other gods, the gods of the nations around you.
For the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. If you follow other gods, his anger will burn against you, and he will wipe you off the face of the earth.
Do not test the LORD your God, as you tested him at Massah.
Be sure to obey the commands of the LORD your God, and the instructions and rules he has given you.
Do what is right and good in the LORD's sight, so that all will go well with you. Then you will go in and take over the good land the LORD promised your ancestors,
and he will drive out all your enemies ahead of you, as he said.
In the future your children will ask you, "What do these instructions, rules, and laws mean that the LORD our God has commanded you?"
Then tell them, "We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand.
Right before our eyes, the LORD sent great and terrible miracles and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on his whole family.
He brought us out of there to lead us into this land and give it to us, the land he promised our ancestors.
The LORD commanded us to obey all these rules and to fear the LORD our God, so that it would always go well with us and he would keep us alive, as he has done until today.
If we are careful to obey all these commands before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us, we will be right with him."
